protocol.scope: Local refinement with supplied seeds, not full-image detection or recall.
protocol.fixture_generation: Independent analytic held-out fixtures, cached once per case.
protocol.timing: Algorithm wall includes Python binding, CPU/GPU submission, wait, solves, verification inside C ABI, and requested CPU polish. Excludes input creation/loading/setup and post-run checks.
protocol.stages: Summed GPU command duration is measured; CPU solve/polish individual timings unavailable. Wall minus GPU is not CPU computation time.
protocol.memory: Process peak includes Python/NumPy/input loading/setup/algorithm; captured before post-run verification. Metal shares system RAM; do not add GPU allocations to RSS.
protocol.precision: p95 is an empirical percentile, not a confidence bound. Independent methods may choose different local maxima.
protocol.accuracy: Accept NCC>=0.8; precise <=0.5px,0.5deg,1%; existing gate <=2px,1deg,2%. Truth is only used for local fixture/seed generation and post-evaluation.
protocol.variants: CPU portable LM; Metal Jacobian/NCC sufficient statistics + CPU small solve; optional bounded CPU polish. CPU accelerated API fallback tested on regressions.

result.stage_timing_note: Current ABI exposes total wall and summed GPU commands only; CPU solve/polish are not individually measured.

result.device: C++ float sampling / double NCC / 8 threads
